snippet.title: Trade Rivals: Goblin Age – Early Access Trailer
snippet.description:
Welcome to Trade Rivals: Goblin Age – the chaotic shop management game where friendships are tested, prices are slashed, and sabotage is just business as usual!

Build your goblin shop, outsmart your rivals, and manipulate the market to crush your friends economically (with love, of course). Pick your shelves, price your goods, and deal with witches, ogres, and outrageous customers.

💰 One wins. The rest? Bankrupt.
🧙‍♀️ Sabotage your friends. Curse their prices.
📈 Outsell. Outwit. Outlast.

🎮 available on July 14th as an Early Access on Steam – grab your friends and find out who the real goblin is!

👉 Add to your wishlist or play now:https://store.steampowered.com/app/3420920/Trade_Rivals__Goblin_Age/

#TradeRivals #GoblinAge #IndieGame #EarlyAccess #GoblinCapitalism
